result.final:
Lowest price for size XS of the Rookmere tee that can actually be bought: $17.76, from Lymington Textiles Official Store (http://localhost:7770/igr-fm02-12.html).

How it was verified: on the Lymington listing the size menu offered XS as a selectable (not disabled/greyed-out) option; I chose XS in the size dropdown and then re-read the page, which showed $17.76 (the listing's pre-selection 'as low as' figure was $13.71, which is not the XS price). So the option was checked as available, not merely listed.

Method: I read all 45 advertised prices from the two results pages, then opened listings in ascending advertised-price order, choosing XS and re-reading the price, and checking whether XS was enabled.
- Opened 12 listings: Chandler Garments ($10.09, XS disabled), Abbotsley ($11.20, no XS option), Carnforth ($11.32, no XS), Elstead ($12.14, XS disabled), Westmere ($12.50, XS disabled), Lymington ($13.71 -> XS $17.76, available = best), Fordwich ($15.49, XS disabled), Garrick ($15.58, XS disabled), Stonebridge ($16.02 -> XS $20.70, available but higher), Alderney ($16.29 -> XS $19.39, available but higher), Marlow ($17.02, no XS), Verity ($17.71, XS disabled).
- Rejected for being unavailable (XS disabled or absent): 9 listings (Chandler, Abbotsley, Carnforth, Elstead, Westmere, Fordwich, Garrick, Marlow, Verity).
- Skipped 33 listings: Bexhill ($18.70) and all 32 listings advertised at or above it, since their advertised price is at or above the best available XS total of $17.76, so none could win.
- Stop condition met: no unopened listing has an advertised price below $17.76.
